q: How many days of privilege, casual and sick leave do Sanjeevani employees get each year?
answer: 21 days of privilege leave, 7 days of casual leave and 7 days of sick leave per calendar year.

q: What is the night-shift allowance for plant employees?
answer: ₹2,800 per month for employees working at least 10 night shifts in the month; otherwise ₹280 per night shift pro-rata.

q: How should Glucosan-M 500 be stored and what is its shelf life?
answer: Store below 30°C and protect from moisture; shelf life is 36 months from the date of manufacture.

q: What is the maximum daily dose of Glucosan-M 500 SR?
answer: 2,000 mg once daily, taken with the evening meal.

q: Can Sanjeevani Cough Relief Syrup be given to a three-year-old child?
doc: Sanjeevani Cough Relief Syrup Product Sheet
answer: No. The syrup must not be used in children below four years of age (mandatory CDSCO label warning).

q: Which product in the Sanjeevani portfolio must be stored below 25°C?
answer: Dermacalm Cream (mometasone 0.1%); in non-air-conditioned warehouses it must be kept in the cool room.

q: How many strips of Glucosan-M samples can a medical representative give a doctor per month?
answer: A maximum of 10 strips per doctor per month.

q: What is the monthly doctor call target for a medical representative in FY27?
answer: 180 doctor visits per MR per month (about 8–9 calls per field day over at least 22 field days).

q: What is the FY27 sales target for the West zone?
answer: ₹425.6 crore, 28% of the ₹1,520 crore national domestic target.

q: What dividend did the Board recommend for FY2025-26?
answer: A final dividend of ₹4.50 per equity share (45% on ₹10 face value), about ₹55.8 crore in total, subject to AGM approval.

q: How is the ₹310 crore Vizag capacity expansion being funded?
answer: ₹190 crore from internal accruals and a term loan of up to ₹120 crore.

q: How many ANDA approvals did Sanjeevani receive in FY2025-26, and for which applications?
answer: Three: ANDAs 215529 (telmisartan), 216604 (glimepiride) and 217248 (atorvastatin).

q: By when must the Unit III Vizag manufacturing licence retention fee be paid?
answer: Internally by 06 November 2026; the statutory deadline is 20 November 2026.

q: As a Band C employee staying at the Baddi plant guest house, what daily allowance do I get?
answer: ₹500 per day: the Band C daily allowance is ₹1,000, reduced by 50% when a plant guest house is used.

q: How long does Sanjeevani take to complete a whistleblower investigation?
answer: Within 60 days of receipt of the complaint; extensions need the Audit Committee Chairperson's approval.

q: What is the Group Mediclaim sum insured for a Band C employee?
answer: ₹5,00,000 family floater (employee, spouse and up to two children).

q: What is the work-from-home allowance for head office employees?
What is the cafeteria meal subsidy at the Hyderabad R&D centre?
Within how long must the Head of QA be informed of a critical deviation at Sanjeevani?
answer: Within 24 hours of discovery (current SOP SPL/QA/SOP-004 v3.0); the investigation closure target for a Critical deviation is 15 working days.

q: What is the dissolution acceptance criterion for Glucosan-M 500 SR tablets?
answer: Not less than 80% (Q) released in 10 hours (with 20–40% at 1 hour and 45–65% at 3 hours).

q: What is the alert level for purified water conductivity?
answer: 1.0 µS/cm; the action level and specification is 1.3 µS/cm at 25°C.

q: What is the finger-dab acceptance limit for Grade C gowning qualification?
answer: Finger dab ≤ 5 CFU per glove, and gown contact plates ≤ 5 CFU per plate.

q: What is the target time to complete a Phase I OOS laboratory investigation?
answer: 5 working days.

q: When did Sanjeevani submit its response to the 2024 US FDA Form 483 for Unit III Vizag?
doc: US FDA Inspection 2024 – Response and CAPA Summary
answer: On 05 April 2024, within 15 business days of the inspection that ended 19 March 2024.

q: During the February 2026 FDA re-inspection, how many OOS results from 2025 did the investigators review and how many were closed within 30 days?
answer: 41 OOS results; 40 were closed within 30 days and 1 was extended with Head QA approval (closed on day 37).

q: How many observations did the Q4 FY26 internal audit of Unit II Baddi raise, by classification?
doc: Internal Audit Report – Unit II Baddi Q4 FY26
answer: 8 observations: 0 Critical, 2 Major and 6 Minor.

q: What exactly was wrong with the label on cough syrup batch CR-2309?
doc: Recall Report – Cough Syrup Batch CR-2309
answer: The bottle label carried the manufacturing licence number of Unit I (Ahmedabad) instead of Unit II (Baddi); all other label information was correct, so there was no safety impact.

q: What was the overall CAPA on-time closure rate in Q1 FY27, and which unit was lowest?
answer: 88% overall against a 90% target; Unit II Baddi was lowest at 78% (Unit I 90%, Unit III 100%).

q: How often do passwords expire on GxP computerised systems under the data integrity policy?
answer: Every 90 days; accounts lock after 3 failed attempts and screens lock after 10 minutes of inactivity.

q: How many expedited pharmacovigilance reports were submitted late in FY2025-26?
answer: 2 out of 143 expedited reports were late (both by one day), giving 98.6% compliance.

q: What long-term storage condition was used in the Glucosan-M 500 SR stability study?
answer: 30°C ± 2°C / 75% ± 5% RH (Climatic Zone IVb), with 40°C/75% RH as the accelerated condition; the data supported a 36-month shelf life.

q: What was the Cmax test/reference ratio and 90% confidence interval in the Cardivas 10 bioequivalence study?
answer: Cmax ratio 98.4% with a 90% CI of 91.2–106.1%, within the 80.00–125.00% limits.

q: What is Sanjeevani's FY27 R&D budget and how much of it goes to the SJ-2041 programme?
answer: ₹185 crore in total, of which ₹62 crore (33.5%) is for the SJ-2041 clinical programme.

q: What HbA1c reduction did SJ-2041 show at the Phase III interim analysis?
answer: −1.1% with SJ-2041 versus −0.6% with the comparator (difference −0.5%), with a dropout rate of 7.4% and 2 serious adverse events judged unrelated.

q: How many patients discontinued the SJ-2041 Phase III trial?
doc: Clinical Site List and Enrolment Status
answer: 92 patients, 7.4% of the 1,240 randomised (as of 30 September 2026).

q: How much does Sanjeevani pay a site for each patient who completes the SJ-2041 trial?
answer: ₹42,000 per completed patient, paid visit by visit, with 10% held back until close-out.

q: What is the compensation insurance cover for the SJ-2041 trial?
answer: Up to ₹10 crore in aggregate, with ₹50 lakh per participant.

q: What is the planned launch price (MRP) of SJ-2041?
What is the plasma half-life of SPL-DP41?
What is the shelf life of Glucosan-M 500?
answer: 36 months from the date of manufacture; store below 30°C and protect from moisture.

answer: Not less than 80% (Q) released in 10 hours.

q: How many days of privilege, casual and sick leave do Sanjeevani employees get?
answer: 21 privilege leave, 7 casual leave and 7 sick leave per calendar year.

q: Within how many working days must site QA approve the initial assessment of a major deviation?
answer: Within 3 working days, with closure targeted within 30 calendar days.

q: What is the pay range for a Grade M2 medical representative?
answer: ₹5.6 lakh to ₹8.4 lakh CTC per year (mid-point ₹7.0 lakh), excluding the quarterly sales incentive.

q: What is the FY27 average increment budget?
answer: ₹28.5 crore, an average increase of 9.5% of fixed pay, effective 01 April 2026 and paid with the June 2026 salary.

q: Does Sanjeevani hire freshers at the Vizag plant?
doc: Careers at Sanjeevani – Hiring and Campus Programme FAQ
answer: Yes. Unit III Vizag hires freshers every year through campus drives at Andhra University and pharmacy colleges in Andhra Pradesh, mainly for QC, production and validation roles.

q: Does Sanjeevani charge a fee for job applications?
doc: Careers at Sanjeevani – Hiring and Campus Programme FAQ
answer: No. Sanjeevani never charges any fee at any stage of hiring; anyone asking for money in its name is committing fraud.

q: What stipend is paid to trainees in the Sanjeevani Graduate Trainee Programme?
What is the FY27 capex for the Vizag expansion this year?
answer: ₹135 crore in FY27, year 1 of the ₹310 crore project (₹150 crore in FY28 and ₹25 crore in FY29 follow).

q: What is the FY27 R&D budget and how is it split between expenses and capital equipment?
answer: ₹185 crore (6.9% of budgeted revenue): ₹177 crore of revenue expenses and ₹8 crore of capital equipment for the Hyderabad labs; ₹62 crore is for SJ-2041.

q: How many credit days does a stockist get?
answer: 30 days from invoice date (15 days for a new stockist in its first 6 months).

q: When are supplies stopped for overdue payments?
answer: When any invoice is more than 15 days overdue (45 days from invoice on 30-day terms), when outstanding exceeds the credit limit by more than 10%, after a dishonoured cheque/NACH, or if the drug licence has expired.

q: What margin does a stockist get on Glucosan-M 500?
doc: Stockist and Distributor Agreement – Standard Terms
answer: 10% on the price to retailer (PTR); the retailer margin is 20% on MRP excluding GST.

q: How much notice ends a stockist agreement?
doc: Stockist and Distributor Agreement – Standard Terms
answer: 60 days' written notice by either party without cause; immediate for material breach or payment default over 90 days.

q: What is the stockist margin on SJ-2041?
Can a pharmacy return near-expiry Dermacalm Cream?
doc: Product Returns and Expiry Replacement Policy
answer: Yes, through its stockist, for replacement, if the tubes are sealed, in their cartons and have 3 months or less of shelf life left, and were stored below 25°C.

q: How are recalled products refunded?
doc: Product Returns and Expiry Replacement Policy
answer: Full credit at the invoice price plus return freight, whether packs are sealed, opened or part-used; the 2% expiry cap does not apply. Patients get a replacement or refund at their pharmacy.

q: When does the new Vizag line start commercial batches?
doc: Project Plan – Vizag Unit III Capacity Expansion
answer: April 2028, for non-US markets; US supply follows PAS approval in FY29.

q: Who owns qualification of the new Vizag line?
doc: Project Plan – Vizag Unit III Capacity Expansion
answer: K. Lavanya, Manager – Validation, Unit III (responsible), with Dr. Farhan Qureshi accountable.

q: Which payment milestone is tied to database lock in the SJ-2041 CRO agreement?
answer: Milestone M6: 20% of the ₹18.6 crore fee, ₹3.72 crore, due on database lock (planned 30 November 2026).

q: Who owns the trial data under the CRO contract?
answer: Sanjeevani Pharma owns all trial data exclusively; the CRO acquires no rights and must transfer the database and trial master file at the end.

q: How do I report a side effect of Cardivas 10?
doc: Medicine Information and Side-Effect Reporting FAQ
answer: Call the 24×7 toll-free safety hotline 1800-233-4100 (option 1), email drugsafety@sanjeevani.example, or tell your doctor or pharmacist; give the batch number, what happened and your contact.

q: How should Glucosan-M be stored at home?
doc: Medicine Information and Side-Effect Reporting FAQ
answer: Below 30°C, protected from moisture: keep tablets in the strip until use and not in the bathroom; shelf life 36 months.
